evals.prompt: What authorities typically govern a high-rise residential tower permit in Riyadh, and what are the first three documents I should lock before schematic design?
evals.expected_output: Answers from master quick reference (AHJ, SBPS, SCD) without loading every subskill; asks for occupancy/AHJ if assuming details; no invented SBC clause numbers.

evals.prompt: Our SCD integrated systems test failed on smoke pressurization. What should we fix before re-inspection, and which module owns this?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sa-scd-licensing-compliance and/or sa-fire-life-safety; cites halt conditions if IST records or NOC status unknown; may reference scd-closeout-checklist.md when loaded via dispatcher.

evals.prompt: We changed egress on site without SBPS amendment. Can we take TOC next week and issue the occupancy certificate?
evals.expected_output: Halts or flags SCD red line per references/compliance.md; does not affirm occupancy readiness; offers remediated pathway (as-built amendment, resubmission).

evals.prompt: Client wants fastest programme on a NEOM hospitality tower. Should we go DBB or EPC, and what contract risks should we flag before tender?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sa-procurement-strategy; compares routes with KSA SBPS/SCD ripple on design changes; references FIDIC or NEC context; does not give legal advice on Particular Conditions.

evals.prompt: We are at DD freeze next week. What should be in the issue pack and who signs off on the transmittal?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sa-deliverables-workstages; mentions RACI, status codes, stage-gate checklist; may cross-link sa-plan-of-work; references deliverables catalog T-XX where relevant.

evals.prompt: What are the KSA-specific gate requirements for RIBA Stage 4 before we issue to tender?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sa-plan-of-work; maps Stage 4 to DD/SBC 601/SCD NOC; references sa-pow-stages-0-7.md; asks for AHJ if missing.

evals.prompt: Building permit issued yesterday. What must we complete before crane erection, including STC fibre protection on the haul route?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sa-site-establishment; cross-checks sa-consent-scheduling for PtC; lists hoarding, TMP, telecom protection; references site-establishment-checklist.md.

evals.prompt: Contractor proposes 5-day floor cycle with façade 2 floors behind structure. What hold points should the architect insist on for SCD?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sa-construction-programme; lists indicative hold points; cross-links sa-scd-licensing-compliance and sa-fire-life-safety; states durations are illustrative.
